description:
[Game reference] Design notes from The Art of Rust. Curated trivia paraphrased from The Art of Rust (Facepunch Studios / Dark Horse Books, January 2026):
design inspirations, cut content and in-universe lore. Each note carries `id`, `chapter`, `title`, `text`
(an original paraphrase, never a quotation), `page` (the book page cited), `tags` (the wiki pages it
belongs to) and `cut_content`. Text only - the book's artwork is never reproduced. Fixed editorial data.

chapter.description: Restrict to one chapter of the book.

cut.description: `true` = only notes about cut/unshipped content; `false` = only notes about shipped content.

tag.description: Only notes tagged for one wiki page: `item:<shortname>`, `monument:<slug>`, `building:<slug>` or `world:<slug>`.

name: get_design_notes
title: Design notes from The Art of Rust
